content.text:
I submitted **index 0 (Sb 0.05 / Y 0.95)** as the best composition, but no composition I measured showed a real photoresponse. Its EQE was 0.00089 %, the only positive reading of the three. The other two readings were slightly negative, so all three values are essentially zero and the ranking between them is probably noise.

- **XRD:** I measured the Sb-rich end and two points in between (Sb 0.26, 0.48 and 0.67). All three show the same pattern of a single fluorite/pyrochlore-type oxide. That points to one wide-bandgap phase across most of the composition line, which would absorb little of the 2.4 eV light.
- **EQE:**

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 28 | 0.67 | −0.00035 |
| 15 | 0.26 | −0.00065 |
| 0 | 0.05 | +0.00089 |

All three merit measurements are used; I used 3 of the 5 XRD measurements. I didn't measure EQE anywhere between Sb 0.26 and 0.67 or between 0.05 and 0.26. A small active region in those gaps can't be ruled out, but the uniform XRD makes one unlikely.
